in_hindi.name: अतिश

in_tamil.name: அடிச்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Atish in Tamil is derived from the Sanskrit word अति (ati), which means 'above, beyond, greater, superior'. The Tamil script does not have a direct equivalent for the Sanskrit letter 'श (sha)', so the name is written as அடிச் (Aṭic) using the Tamil letters அடி (adi) and ச் (cha).
